caveats: ForTest is not Populator output and transforms bounds.
Shell app_process access/registration does not prove app instrumentation access or native SurfaceFlinger permission.
Binder strings/hashcodes/native input-channel pointers do not establish cross-process IWindow identity.
Final accessibility window-ID/token access cannot recover an omitted IME and may require SYSTEM_UID.

proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.name: API37 instrumentation-local real Binder identity bridge positive control
proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.scope: One standalone method in the existing compat instrumentation context on a dedicated API37 emulator; no original Notes methods, no Agent service, no old matrix status change.
proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.prerequisite: Fixed-source review of UiAutomation shell permission adoption all the way to the native SurfaceFlinger PermissionCache/check path. Effective ACCESS_SURFACE_FLINGER delegation is currently unproved; do not claim it from shell success.
proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.permissionGate: If the reviewed path permits it, adopt only ACCESS_SURFACE_FLINGER in this independent test, record actual pre/post permission observations and actual single ForTest registration outcome, then always drop adopted identity. Do not modify hidden-API policy, exemptions or root; denial, missing callback, process abort or unavailable cleanup remains a failed/unknown observation.

ipc.direction: Existing shell raw collector -> a narrowly guarded test-only endpoint in the same process that owns the ForTest listener
ipc.payload: Real IBinder references plus bounded copied raw metadata and source/run/attempt/session binding; never Binder.toString/hash/native pointer identity
ipc.authorization: Validate caller UID2000, one active per-run nonce/session, expected process identity, API37, display0, configured IME package/UID; one accepted handoff. No arbitrary operations or shell strings.
ipc.bounds: Reuse raw handle/candidate/callback/binder caps and explicitly bound serialized IPC payload; hold at most the already frozen candidate Binder set. Any overflow or duplicate session is incomplete.
ipc.threading: No IPC, waits, dumps or serialization in either listener callback. Copy bounded values only. Shell transfers the frozen snapshot outside its callback while both endpoints still retain their Binder references.
ipc.comparison: In the receiving instrumentation process compare actual retained IBinder identities from the IPC and ForTest callback. Assign only local ordinals to output. Do not equate string representations across processes.

proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.stimulus: One predeclared controlled editor show request after both listeners are ready; restore any dedicated-emulator keyboard setting at the end. Use an explicitly separate diagnostic observation interval, not the original v4 confirmation timer.
proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.results: Separate permission/admission, each registration/unregistration attempt, initial cache, natural callbacks, source/config stability, raw candidate counts and unique Binder count, real Binder match counts, and each stream clock. Record late matches without calling them original Notes passes.
proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.successBoundary: A unique raw configured-package/UID/type2011/display0 Binder observed and matched in the same instrumentation process establishes this new diagnostic identity channel only. It does not establish final accessibility window-ID mapping, a common SF transaction/frame, the original 8 failures cause, or API36/31/32 support.
proposedLaterMinimalDeviceExperiment.cleanup: Freeze collectors; at most one explicit unregister per registration attempt; retain thrown/aborted outcomes; drop adopted permissions; terminate only owned processes and restore settings. Native unregister return is not an independent SF removal acknowledgement.
